Transaction packing, scheduling, and validation logic with treaps, maps, bitsets, and bundle handling.

# Purpose
`fd_pack.c` implements the main transaction packing engine. It defines the internal `fd_pack_t` state and the data structures used to manage pending transactions, vote transactions, bundles, penalty treaps, expiration order, signature lookup, durable nonce lookup, account use tracking, and bitset-based conflict tracking. The file also provides the memory layout, creation, join, leave, and delete functions for the pack object, plus helper logic for reward and compute estimation, durable nonce validation, duplicate account checks, and bundle handling.

The file also contains the scheduling logic that selects transactions for each microblock while enforcing block limits, account conflict rules, write-cost limits, expiration rules, and bundle rules. It supports insertion and removal of single transactions and bundles, microblock completion, block end cleanup, rebate handling, expiration processing, and state reset. It also includes [`fd_pack_verify`](<#fd_pack_verify>), which checks internal consistency across the pool, treaps, maps, bitsets, and bank-tile tracking structures.
